name: Shikabe (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shikabe town emblem in navy and red: a navy broken ring of maze-like segments enclosing a red stylised device.
history: Municipal flag of Shikabe, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 4 January 1920.

features.role: Shikabe town emblem — a navy broken ring of maze-like segments enclosing a red stylised device
